parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of durable ABS plastic, typically rectangular with a small nozzle or pump head.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator for dispensing liquid when pressed, controlling the flow through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring or internal mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent polycarbonate to hold liquid contents.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid and supports the pressing lid, ensuring stability and containment of the fluid.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing structural support for the pressing mechanism.
